allowed=set(report['allowed_changed_objects']);bad=[r['name'] for r in before if r['name'] not in allowed and (craft.objects.get(r['name']) is None or ns['digest'](craft.objects[r['name']])!=r['hash'])]
assert not bad,bad
assert not bpy.data.is_dirty
checks=['All untargeted editable components retain mesh, transforms, UV and material references','Source saved']

checks.append('No craft components added or removed')

def shore(z):return 8+2*math.sin(z*.14)+.6*math.sin(z*.37+.4)+2.2*math.exp(-((z+2.5)/3.6)**2)-.85*math.exp(-((z-2.5)/2.34)**2)
def land_offset(x,y):
 a=math.radians(-81.5);wx=11.15+math.cos(a)*x-math.sin(a)*y;wz=34-math.sin(a)*x-math.cos(a)*y
 return wx-shore(wz)
stair=[]
for i,o in enumerate(sorted([o for o in craft.objects if o.name.startswith('Combined_front_A outer steps')],key=lambda o:o.name)):
 assert abs(o.rotation_euler.z-math.pi/2)<1e-5
 assert abs(o.location.x-(4.63+.28*i))<1e-5 and abs(o.location.y+3.15)<1e-5
 pts=[o.matrix_world@Vector(v) for v in o.bound_box];minimum=min(land_offset(v.x,v.y) for v in pts)

 stair.append({'name':o.name,'minimum_inland_offset':minimum})
